response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS n FROM film f LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), a1 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS m FROM c), s1 AS (SELECT c.film_id, c.n, c.n - a1.m AS ex1 FROM c CROSS JOIN a1 WHERE a1.m IS NOT NULL AND c.n > a1.m), a2 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS m FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.film_id, s1.n, s1.ex1, s1.n - a2.m AS ex2 FROM s1 CROSS JOIN a2 WHERE a2.m IS NOT NULL AND s1.n > a2.m) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_actor_count, AVG(ex1) AS avg_excess_over_first_avg, AVG(ex2) AS avg_excess_over_second_avg FROM s2
